failed_preliminary_construction_runs.correction: Separate the lean public pending owner from a private completion owner holding returned resources/mapping. No allocation on cancellation failure and no lint suppression.

manual.scope: Affected/adjacent pages and Configuration contents; remainder not re-audited

limitations: Observation deadline excludes dependency lookup, whole TLS/SCRAM exchanges, scheduling progress and blocking kernel mapping/cancellation latency. Deferred start arms no autonomous cancellation.

New-wrapper mapping failure and forced kernel wait-admission failure were not natively injected. Inspected exact owner/error propagation plus existing runtime timed-loan rejection test is not exhaustive wrapper fault coverage.

Native deterministic fixture bytes are public data from an unregistered local peer, never installed as RNG or used by crypto. Real Cortex-A710 S3/Kafka uses owned VirtIO RNG because that CPU lacks RNDR.

RNG service allocates reply backing on its own account. Authority-holding raw callers/deferred owners can retain that backing. Caller-funded replies and retention-pressure qualification remain SEC-07 work; no claim ungranted callers can acquire authority.
Startup name-service lookup and RNG server publication/receive readiness are separate gaps. Runtime cancellation supplies no DMA quiescence or physical retirement proof.
Host interop uses cfg(test) host entropy. No new forced cancellation-rejection/domain-abort native test or whole-workspace signing/launch suite rerun in this batch.

TLS key-schedule/HKDF/IV, compiler-copy and forced-termination erasure, intermediate chains, third-party provenance/license, hardware timing, production trust and other SEC-18 contexts remain unqualified.
Passing HTTP retries and controlled Kafka recovery do not establish causes for historical intermittent failures. No kernel source behavior or formal model changed.
